findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_email_check, x402_preflight, web_link_check, web_extract · Private data: base_token_check, base_token_price, base_balance, base_tx, evm_decode_calldata, evm_typed_data_check, ens_resolve, domain_dns, base_portfolio, wallet_screen, web_link_check · Public sink: domain_email_check, ens_resolve, domain_whois, wallet_screen · Destructive: web_security_headers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_email_check, x402_preflight, web_link_check, web_extract · Private data: base_token_check, base_token_price, base_balance, base_tx, evm_decode_calldata, evm_typed_data_check, ens_resolve, domain_dns, base_portfolio, wallet_screen, web_link_check · Public sink: domain_email_check, ens_resolve, domain_whois, wallet_screen · Destructive: web_security_headers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
